response.justification: The candidate significantly exceeds the 6+ years requirement with nearly two decades of fullstack experience, strong TypeScript/Node.js depth, recent hands-on AI agent and MCP tooling work, and a demonstrated software craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, testing frameworks authorship). While Nest.js, Vitest, and Kotlin are not explicitly evidenced and his frontend history leans more toward Ember.js than React, the breadth, polyglot ability, and directly relevant AI-agent experience make him a strong fit worth interviewing.
strengths: Deep fullstack TypeScript/Node.js experience plus recent AI-agent and MCP infrastructure work
Strong testing and craftsmanship background (TDD, authored test frameworks, CI/CD, trunk-based development)
Proven polyglot with cloud/containerization experience (AWS CDK, Docker, Kubernetes)
concerns: No explicit Nest.js or Vitest experience listed in the primary stack
React exposure appears limited compared to extensive Ember.js history
Kotlin and Python not evidenced; Java experience appears dated

key_factors.factor: Missing Nest.js/Vitest and limited React evidence
